---
title: "Exposure associations with incident diseases and all-cause mortality"
format: html
execute:
  eval: false
  echo: true
---

## Setup

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(broom)
  library(fastDummies)
  library(survival)
})

disease_dir <- "data/diseases"
exposure_path <- "data/exposure_phenotypes.rds"
exposure_metadata_path <- "data/exposure_metadata.csv"
white_id_path <- "data/white_british_ids.txt"
covariate_path <- "data/covariates.tsv"
mortality_path <- "data/all_cause_mortality.tsv"
result_dir <- "results/06_exposure_disease"
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

case_frequency_cutoff <- 0.001

quote_name <- function(x) {
  paste0("`", gsub("`", "", x, fixed = TRUE), "`")
}
```

## Exposure data

```{r}
remove_outliers_and_scale <- function(x) {
  x_median <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_iqr <- IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x[x < x_median - 4 * x_iqr | x > x_median + 4 * x_iqr] <- NA_real_
  as.numeric(scale(x))
}

exposure_list <- readRDS(exposure_path)
exposure_metadata <- readr::read_csv(
  exposure_metadata_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

nominal_df <- exposure_list$CatUnord_phenotype |>
  fastDummies::dummy_columns(
    select_columns = setdiff(names(exposure_list$CatUnord_phenotype), "eid"),
    remove_selected_columns = TRUE,
    ignore_na = TRUE
  )

continuous_df <- exposure_list$Cont_phenotype |>
  mutate(across(-eid, remove_outliers_and_scale))

exposure_df <- list(
  exposure_list$Binary_phenotype,
  exposure_list$CatOrd_phenotype,
  nominal_df,
  continuous_df
) |>
  reduce(full_join, by = "eid") |>
  mutate(eid = as.character(eid))

excluded_categories <- c(
  "EXCLUDE",
  "LOWSAMPLESIZE",
  "Online follow-up",
  "Physical activity (accelerometer data)"
)
included_fields <- exposure_metadata |>
  filter(!Category %in% excluded_categories) |>
  pull(FieldID) |>
  as.character()

exposures <- setdiff(names(exposure_df), "eid")
exposures <- exposures[stringr::str_split_i(exposures, "[#_]", 1) %in% included_fields]

white_ids <- readr::read_lines(white_id_path)
eligible_ids <- intersect(exposure_df$eid, white_ids)

covariate_df <- readr::read_tsv(covariate_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(eid = as.character(IID))
covariates <- intersect(
  c("Sex", "Age", "Fasting", "Month", "Center"),
  names(covariate_df)
)
```

## Disease selection

```{r}
read_disease <- function(path) {
  disease_raw <- readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if (all(c("eid", "status", "years") %in% names(disease_raw))) {
    disease_raw |>
      transmute(
        eid = as.character(eid),
        status = as.numeric(status),
        years = as.numeric(years)
      )
  } else {
    disease_raw |>
      transmute(
        eid = as.character(eid),
        status = as.numeric(target_y),
        years = as.numeric(BL2Target_yrs)
      )
  }
}

disease_files <- list.files(
  disease_dir,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

disease_summary <- map_dfr(disease_files, function(path) {
  disease_df <- read_disease(path) |>
    filter(eid %in% eligible_ids, years >= 0) |>
    drop_na(status, years)

  tibble(
    disease = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path)),
    path = path,
    total_n = nrow(disease_df),
    case_n = sum(disease_df$status == 1),
    control_n = sum(disease_df$status == 0),
    case_freq = case_n / total_n
  )
})

selected_diseases <- disease_summary |>
  filter(case_freq > case_frequency_cutoff)

readr::write_csv(
  selected_diseases,
  file.path(result_dir, "selected_incident_diseases.csv")
)
```

## Exposure-disease Cox models

```{r}
fit_exposure_cox <- function(disease_name, disease_path, exposure) {
  model_df <- read_disease(disease_path) |>
    filter(eid %in% eligible_ids, years >= 0) |>
    inner_join(covariate_df, by = "eid") |>
    inner_join(exposure_df |> select(eid, all_of(exposure)), by = "eid") |>
    drop_na(status, years, all_of(covariates), all_of(exposure)) |>
    mutate(across(any_of(c("Month", "Center")), as.factor))

  model_fit <- coxph(
    reformulate(
      c(covariates, quote_name(exposure)),
      response = "survival::Surv(years, status)"
    ),
    data = model_df
  )

  broom::tidy(model_fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    filter(stringr::str_remove_all(term, "`") == exposure) |>
    transmute(
      disease = disease_name,
      exposure = exposure,
      HR = estimate,
      HR_lower = conf.low,
      HR_upper = conf.high,
      p.value,
      n = nobs(model_fit),
      events = sum(model_df$status == 1)
    )
}

exposure_disease_results <- pmap_dfr(
  selected_diseases |> select(disease, path),
  function(disease, path) {
    map_dfr(exposures, ~ fit_exposure_cox(disease, path, .x))
  }
)

readr::write_tsv(
  exposure_disease_results,
  file.path(result_dir, "exposure_incident_disease.tsv")
)
```

## All-cause mortality

```{r}
mortality_df <- readr::read_tsv(mortality_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  transmute(
    eid = as.character(IID),
    status = as.numeric(ACM_event_indicator),
    time = as.numeric(ACM_survival_time)
  ) |>
  filter(eid %in% eligible_ids, time >= 0)

exposure_mortality_results <- map_dfr(exposures, function(exposure) {
  model_df <- mortality_df |>
    inner_join(covariate_df, by = "eid") |>
    inner_join(exposure_df |> select(eid, all_of(exposure)), by = "eid") |>
    drop_na(status, time, all_of(covariates), all_of(exposure)) |>
    mutate(across(any_of(c("Month", "Center")), as.factor))

  model_fit <- coxph(
    reformulate(
      c(covariates, quote_name(exposure)),
      response = "survival::Surv(time, status)"
    ),
    data = model_df
  )

  broom::tidy(model_fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    filter(stringr::str_remove_all(term, "`") == exposure) |>
    transmute(
      outcome = "all_cause_mortality",
      exposure = exposure,
      HR = estimate,
      HR_lower = conf.low,
      HR_upper = conf.high,
      p.value,
      n = nobs(model_fit),
      events = sum(model_df$status == 1)
    )
})

readr::write_tsv(
  exposure_mortality_results,
  file.path(result_dir, "exposure_all_cause_mortality.tsv")
)
```
